Analise o(s) documento(s) de cenário do projeto e gere o SRS completo no formato especificado, seguindo o processo de trabalho: buscas dedicadas na base de conhecimento para cada tipo de artefato, rastreabilidade validada entre os artefatos.

Documento(s) de cenário:
--- Project Scenario 8.pdf ---
BECS (Book E-Commerce System)
So basically what we're trying to do is get books selling 
online instead of however you guys are doing it now, just a 
simple site where people can come in, look through what's 
available, throw a few books in a cart and check out. Nothing 
crazy, I just want it to actually work and not be a headache 
to keep up with. Right now I think it's all kind of manual or 
scattered and there's no real way for someone to just browse 
and buy without someone in the middle handling it, so that's 
the itch we're trying to scratch here. 
 
Anybody coming to the site should be able to just make an 
account, that's it, no big verification process or anything, 
and once they're in they can search for books and see title, 
author, price, add stuff to their cart and go through 
checkout. Keep the search simple, just matching on the title 
and it has to be exact, nothing fancy like partial matches or 
letting people search by author, that's more than we need 
right now. Some of these people might want to sign up to get 
notified about promotions and deals, so let's call those folks 
members, and they're the ones who can use promo codes when 
they check out. I picture this being pretty bare-bones in 
terms of who can buy what, like one copy of each book per 
order is plenty, we don't need people stacking ten copies of 
the same thing in their cart. 
 
On my side of things, I need a way to manage the inventory, 
basically a login that lets me add new books, edit prices, see 
how much stock I've got, that kind of stuff. I also want the 
system to ping me, like an email or something, whenever a book 
is running low so I don't get caught without stock, unless 
I've told it not to bother for that particular book because 
maybe I'm discontinuing it. And I want to be able to set up 
these percentage-off promotions every now and then and have it 
just email all the members automatically when I create one. 
 
One thing I want to be upfront about, we don't need to 
actually process real credit cards or handle real money 
movement right now, just collect the card number as part of 
the checkout flow and spit out a receipt and keep a log of 
what was purchased, who bought it, when. The real payment 
processing piece is something for way later, not part of this. 
Same with security stuff, I know that sounds bad, but honestly 
for what we need right now I'm not worried about encryption or 
people forgetting passwords or whatever, that's not a 
priority, let's not spend time building password recovery or 
anything like that for now. 
 
There's only going to be one person managing the store, me 
basically, so don't worry about building out roles for 
multiple managers or anything fancy like that, and a manager 
should never also be a regular customer account, those are two 
separate hats. It just needs to run somewhere people can get 
to it through a normal browser, nothing exotic on the 
technical side, just something stable that people in here can 
pull up and use without issues.

Sistema: BECS (Book E-Commerce System)

Resumo executivo: BECS is a browser-based e-commerce system that replaces the store's manual and fragmented book-selling process. It enables customers to create accounts, browse and search the catalog, manage a cart, use eligible promotions, and complete simulated checkouts. It also enables a single store manager to maintain books, prices, stock, low-stock alerts, promotions, and purchase records.

Escopo: BECS supports online book catalog browsing, simulated purchasing, inventory administration, promotional campaigns, and sales record keeping.
  Em escopo: Customer account registration and authentication
  Em escopo: Book catalog browsing and exact-title search
  Em escopo: Shopping cart management with one copy of each book per order
  Em escopo: Optional member enrollment
  Em escopo: Member-only promotional code application
  Em escopo: Checkout with card-number collection and no real payment processing
  Em escopo: Receipt generation and purchase logging
  Em escopo: Manager authentication and book inventory management
  Em escopo: Low-stock monitoring and email alerts
  Em escopo: Percentage-based promotion creation
  Em escopo: Automatic promotion emails to members
  Fora de escopo: Real payment authorization, settlement, or money movement — deferred to a future version
  Fora de escopo: Search by author or partial title — explicitly excluded from the current version
  Fora de escopo: Password recovery — explicitly excluded from the current version
  Fora de escopo: Encryption-related functionality — explicitly deprioritized for the current version
  Fora de escopo: Multiple manager accounts or manager role hierarchies — only one manager is required
  Fora de escopo: Purchasing multiple copies of the same book in one order — prohibited by store policy
  Premissa: PA-01: [INFERRED] Customers provide a valid email address during registration.
  Premissa: PA-02: [INFERRED] An email delivery service is available for notifications.
  Premissa: PA-03: [INFERRED] Each catalog book has a unique internal identifier.
  Premissa: PA-04: [INFERRED] The manager defines the stock quantity considered low for each book.
  Premissa: PA-05: [INFERRED] A submitted order contains at least one available book.
  Restrição: REST-01 (Business): Only one manager account shall exist.
  Restrição: REST-02 (Access): A manager account shall not also be a customer account.
  Restrição: REST-03 (Search): Book searches shall use exact title matching only.
  Restrição: REST-04 (Order): An order shall contain no more than one copy of each book.
  Restrição: REST-05 (Payment): BECS shall not authorize or transfer real payments.
  Restrição: REST-06 (Technology): BECS shall be accessible through a standard web browser.
  Restrição: REST-07 (Security): Password recovery and encryption functionality are excluded from this version.

Stakeholders:
  STK-01 - Prospective customer (Primary user): Create a customer account without a complex verification process.
  STK-02 - Registered customer (Primary user): Browse books, search by exact title, manage a cart, complete checkout, and receive a receipt.
  STK-03 - Member (Primary user): Receive promotional notifications and apply promotional codes during checkout.
  STK-04 - Store manager (Primary user): Maintain the catalog, prices, stock, alerts, promotions, and purchase records.
  STK-05 - Email delivery service (External stakeholder): [INFERRED] Receive outbound email requests for low-stock and promotional notifications.

Regras de negócio:
  RN-001 - Exact-title search: Book searches shall match the complete title exactly; partial-title and author searches are not permitted.
  RN-002 - Member-only promotional codes: Only customers enrolled as members may use promotional codes.
  RN-003 - One copy per book: An order may contain no more than one copy of each book.
  RN-004 - Optional membership: A customer becomes a member only by opting in to promotional communications.
  RN-005 - Low-stock notification policy: The manager shall be notified when a book reaches its low-stock threshold unless alerts are disabled for that book.
  RN-006 - Percentage-based promotions: Promotional discounts shall be expressed as a percentage of the eligible price.
  RN-007 - Promotion announcement: Every active member shall be notified when a new promotion is created.
  RN-008 - Exclusive account types: A manager account and a customer account shall represent separate identities.
  RN-009 - Single manager: The store shall have exactly one manager account.
  RN-010 - Simulated payment: Checkout shall collect a card number without authorizing, capturing, or transferring money.
  RN-011 - Purchase audit information: Each completed purchase shall identify the purchased books, the customer, and the purchase date and time.
  RN-012 - Registration without verification: Customer registration shall not require a separate identity or email verification process.
  RN-013 - Stock deduction: [INFERRED] Completing an order shall reduce stock by one unit for every book in the order.

Requisitos funcionais:
  RF-001 - Register customer account: The system shall register a customer account without a separate verification step. [Must have]
  RF-002 - Authenticate customer: The system shall authenticate a registered customer using account credentials. [Must have]
  RF-003 - Browse available books: The system shall list books currently available for purchase. [Must have]
  RF-004 - Search by exact title: The system shall return books whose complete title exactly matches the submitted search value. [Must have]
  RF-005 - Display book information: The system shall display the title, author, price, and availability of each presented book. [Must have]
  RF-006 - Enroll as member: The system shall enroll a customer as a member after the customer opts in to promotional communications. [Should have]
  RF-007 - Add book to cart: The system shall add one copy of a selected book to the customer's cart. [Must have]
  RF-008 - View cart: The system shall display the books and prices currently contained in the customer's cart. [Must have]
  RF-009 - Remove book from cart: The system shall remove a selected book from the customer's cart. [Should have]
  RF-010 - Apply promotional code: The system shall apply a valid promotional code only to a member's checkout. [Should have]
  RF-011 - Collect card number: The system shall collect a card number during checkout. [Must have]
  RF-012 - Complete simulated checkout: The system shall complete an order without requesting real payment authorization. [Must have]
  RF-013 - Generate receipt: The system shall generate a receipt after successful order completion. [Must have]
  RF-014 - Record purchase: The system shall record the purchased books, customer identifier, and completion timestamp for each order. [Must have]
  RF-015 - Authenticate manager: The system shall authenticate the single manager account using manager credentials. [Must have]
  RF-016 - Enforce account separation: The system shall reject assignment of both manager and customer account types to the same identity. [Must have]
  RF-017 - Add book: The system shall allow the authenticated manager to add a book to the catalog. [Must have]
  RF-018 - Edit book price: The system shall allow the authenticated manager to change a book's price. [Must have]
  RF-019 - View stock: The system shall display the current stock quantity for each book to the authenticated manager. [Must have]
  RF-020 - Update stock: The system shall allow the authenticated manager to update a book's stock quantity. [Must have]
  RF-021 - Set low-stock threshold: The system shall allow the authenticated manager to define a low-stock threshold for each book. [Must have]
  RF-022 - Disable low-stock alert: The system shall allow the authenticated manager to disable low-stock alerts for a selected book. [Must have]
  RF-023 - Send low-stock alert: The system shall email the manager when an alert-enabled book reaches its low-stock threshold. [Must have]
  RF-024 - Create promotion: The system shall allow the authenticated manager to create a percentage-based promotion. [Must have]
  RF-025 - Notify members of promotion: The system shall email every active member after a promotion is created. [Must have]
  RF-026 - Deduct purchased stock: The system shall reduce stock by one unit for every book in a completed order. [Must have]
  RF-027 - View purchase log: The system shall allow the authenticated manager to view recorded purchases. [Should have]

Requisitos não funcionais:
  RNF-001 (Performance Efficiency) - The system shall return catalog, search, cart, and inventory pages within 2 seconds at the 95th percentile under 100 concurrent users. [TBD] | Métrica: At least 95% of measured responses complete within 2 seconds under 100 concurrent users. [TBD]
  RNF-002 (Performance Efficiency) - The system shall generate the checkout result and receipt within 3 seconds of order submission. [TBD] | Métrica: At least 95% of valid checkout submissions produce a receipt within 3 seconds. [TBD]
  RNF-003 (Reliability) - The system shall maintain monthly availability of at least 99.5%. [TBD] | Métrica: Monthly measured availability is at least 99.5%, excluding approved maintenance windows. [TBD]
  RNF-004 (Compatibility) - The system shall support the two latest stable versions of Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari. [TBD] | Métrica: 100% of critical user journeys pass on the two latest stable versions of the four specified browsers. [TBD]
  RNF-005 (Interaction Capability) - The system shall enable a first-time customer to complete registration and a simulated purchase within 10 minutes without formal training. [TBD] | Métrica: At least 4 of 5 representative first-time users complete the journey within 10 minutes without assistance. [TBD]
  RNF-006 (Reliability) - The system shall submit low-stock and promotion emails to the configured email service within 60 seconds of the triggering event. [TBD] | Métrica: At least 99% of notification requests are submitted within 60 seconds. [TBD]
  RNF-007 (Maintainability) - The system shall maintain automated test coverage of at least 80% for business-rule code. [TBD] | Métrica: Business-rule code reports at least 80% line coverage in the delivery pipeline. [TBD]
  RNF-008 (Functional Suitability) - The system shall return only titles that exactly equal the submitted search value. | Métrica: 100% of search results match the submitted complete title; partial and author-only queries return zero results.

Critérios de aceite:
  CA-001 - Dado a visitor has supplied all required registration fields, quando the visitor submits registration, então the system shall create the customer account without requesting a separate verification step
  CA-002 - Dado a registered customer has valid credentials, quando the customer submits those credentials, então the system shall authenticate the customer and display the customer area
  CA-003 - Dado the catalog contains available and unavailable books, quando the customer opens the available-books catalog, então the system shall list only books whose stock quantity is greater than zero
  CA-004 - Dado the catalog contains a book titled 'Example Book', quando the customer searches for the complete title 'Example Book', então the system shall return that book, while the partial query 'Example' shall return zero results
  CA-005 - Dado a book is included in a catalog or search result, quando the result is displayed, então the system shall display its title, author, price, and availability
  CA-006 - Dado an authenticated non-member customer is viewing promotional preferences, quando the customer opts in, então the system shall set the account's member status to 'active'
  CA-007 - Dado a book is available and is not currently in the customer's cart, quando the customer adds the book, então the system shall place exactly one copy in the cart and reject a second addition of the same book
  CA-008 - Dado the cart contains two different books, quando the customer opens the cart, então the system shall display both books and their current prices
  CA-009 - Dado the customer's cart contains a selected book, quando the customer removes the book, então the system shall remove that book and exclude its price from the cart total
  CA-010 - Dado an active member has a valid 10% promotional code and a cart total of 100 monetary units, quando the member applies the code, então the system shall display a discount of 10 monetary units and a resulting total of 90 monetary units
  CA-011 - Dado the customer is on the checkout page, quando the customer submits the required card-number field, então the system shall accept the field as checkout input without requesting payment authorization
  CA-012 - Dado the cart contains available books and the required checkout fields are present, quando the customer submits the order, então the system shall assign the order status 'Completed' without invoking a real payment processor
  CA-013 - Dado an order has completed successfully, quando the completion is recorded, então the system shall generate one receipt containing the order identifier and purchased books
  CA-014 - Dado an order has completed successfully, quando the system records the purchase, então the stored record shall contain every purchased book, the customer identifier, and the completion timestamp
  CA-015 - Dado the single manager account has valid credentials, quando the manager submits those credentials, então the system shall authenticate the manager and display the management area
  CA-016 - Dado an identity is already assigned the customer account type, quando the same identity is submitted for manager assignment, então the system shall reject the assignment and preserve the customer account type
  CA-017 - Dado the authenticated manager supplies valid book information, quando the manager submits the new book, então the system shall create exactly one catalog record for the book
  CA-018 - Dado a catalog book has a price of 20 monetary units, quando the manager changes the price to 25 monetary units, então the system shall display and use 25 monetary units as the book's current price
  CA-019 - Dado a book has a recorded stock quantity of 7, quando the manager views the book's inventory information, então the system shall display a stock quantity of 7
  CA-020 - Dado a book has a recorded stock quantity of 7, quando the manager updates the quantity to 12, então the system shall store and display a stock quantity of 12
  CA-021 - Dado an authenticated manager is editing a book, quando the manager sets its low-stock threshold to 3, então the system shall store 3 as the book's low-stock threshold
  CA-022 - Dado a book has low-stock alerts enabled, quando the manager disables alerts for that book, então the system shall set its alert status to 'disabled' and submit zero low-stock emails for it
  CA-023 - Dado an alert-enabled book has a threshold of 3 and its stock becomes 3, quando the stock update is completed, então the system shall submit one low-stock email to the manager within 60 seconds [TBD]
  CA-024 - Dado the manager supplies a unique code and a discount percentage of 15, quando the manager submits the promotion, então the system shall create one promotion with a 15% discount
  CA-025 - Dado a promotion is created while 20 customers have active member status, quando promotion creation completes, então the system shall submit exactly 20 promotion email requests within 60 seconds [TBD]
  CA-026 - Dado an order contains three different books with sufficient stock, quando the order reaches status 'Completed', então the system shall reduce each included book's stock quantity by exactly one
  CA-027 - Dado at least one completed purchase is recorded, quando the authenticated manager opens the purchase log, então the system shall display the purchased books, customer identifier, and completion timestamp for each record

Glossário:
  BECS: Book E-Commerce System, the browser-based system specified by this document.
  Customer: A registered user permitted to browse books, manage a cart, and complete checkout.
  Member: A customer who has opted in to promotional communications and may use promotional codes.
  Manager: The single account responsible for catalog, inventory, promotion, and purchase-log administration.
  Exact-title search: A search that returns a book only when its complete title equals the submitted search value.
  Promotion: A percentage-based discount associated with a promotional code.
  Low-stock threshold: The manager-defined stock quantity at or below which an enabled low-stock alert is triggered.
  Simulated checkout: Order completion that collects a card number but performs no real payment authorization or money movement.
  Purchase log: The collection of completed purchase records containing purchased books, customer identity, and completion time.
  Available book: A catalog book whose recorded stock quantity is greater than zero.

Este documento é a base de conhecimento fixa (Vector Store B) do sistema de elicitação de requisitos. Ele ensina ao agente
de IA os padrões de escrita, templates, exemplos e regras de qualidade que devem ser aplicados ao analisar documentos 
de projeto.PARTE 1 — Estrutura do Documento de Especificação de Requisitos (SRS)
Base: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018 §9.6 · IEEE 830-1998 §3 · Sommerville (2016, cap. 4)
O Documento de Especificação de Requisitos de Software (SRS) é o contrato técnico que descreve o 
que o sistema deve fazer e sob quais condições de qualidade. Ele serve de referência para 
desenvolvedores, testadores, gerentes e clientes durante todo o ciclo de vida do projeto.
1.1 Artefatos Obrigatórios e sua Ordem
Um SRS completo e formal deve conter os seguintes artefatos, nesta ordem:
• ESCOPO: Define o que está DENTRO e FORA do projeto. Evita scope creep.
• STAKEHOLDERS: Lista todos os envolvidos: quem usa, quem financia, quem é afetado.
• PREMISSAS E RESTRIÇÕES: Fatos assumidos como verdadeiros e limites impostos ao projeto.
• REGRAS DE NEGÓCIO (RN): Políticas, fórmulas e condições de negócio que existem independentemente 
do software.
• REQUISITOS FUNCIONAIS (RF): O que o sistema DEVE FAZER — comportamentos, serviços, respostas a 
entradas.
• REQUISITOS NÃO FUNCIONAIS (RNF): Como o sistema deve SER — atributos de qualidade 
quantificáveis.
• HISTÓRIAS DE USUÁRIO (HU): Necessidades na perspectiva do usuário: Como [perfil], quero [ação], para
[benefício].
• CASOS DE USO (UC): Interações detalhadas ator-sistema com fluxo principal, alternativo e exceções.
• CRITÉRIOS DE ACEITE (CA): Condições testáveis em formato BDD (Dado/Quando/Então) que definem 
quando o requisito está concluído.
• GLOSSÁRIO: Termos do domínio com definição precisa para eliminar ambiguidades.
1.2 Como os Artefatos se Interconectam
Os artefatos formam uma cadeia de rastreabilidade. Cada RF deve ter origem em um STK 
(stakeholder) ou RN. Cada HU deve ter pelo menos um RF associado. Cada RF e HU devem ter pelo menos um CA. Esta rastreabilidade garante que nada seja implementado sem justificativa de 
negócio e que tudo que foi prometido seja testável.
Cadeia de rastreabilidade mínima:
STK → (RN →) RF → HU → CA

[ ] Necessário: Existe uma necessidade real de negócio ou stakeholder que justifica este requisito.
[ ] Não ambíguo: O requisito tem uma única interpretação possível para qualquer leitor.
[ ] Verificável: Existe um teste ou critério objetivo para confirmar que o requisito foi atendido.
[ ] Singular: O requisito descreve uma única capacidade ou restrição.
[ ] Viável: É tecnicamente possível implementar dentro das restrições do projeto.
[ ] Rastreável: Tem origem (stakeholder ou RN) e pode ser vinculado a um caso de teste.
[ ] Completo: Contém todas as informações necessárias sem referências pendentes (TBD).
[ ] Consistente: Não conflita com nenhum outro requisito do documento.

Quando um trecho de texto é ambíguo, aplicar estas perguntas diagnósticas:
É RN ou RF?
Pergunta: 'Esta regra existiria sem software?' SIM → RN. NÃO → RF.
Pergunta: 'Menciona tela, botão, banco de dados ou API?' SIM → RF.
Pergunta: 'É uma política de negócio de uma área?' SIM → RN.
É RF ou RNF?
Pergunta: 'Descreve uma AÇÃO do sistema?' SIM → RF.
Pergunta: 'Descreve uma QUALIDADE/PROPRIEDADE do sistema?' SIM → RNF.
Teste: 'O sistema deve [verbo]...' → RF. 'O sistema deve ter [atributo]...' → RNF.
É HU ou RF?
HU = perspectiva do USUÁRIO, linguagem de negócio, descreve NECESSIDADE.
RF = perspectiva do SISTEMA, linguagem técnica, descreve COMPORTAMENTO.
Uma HU geralmente gera 1 ou mais RFs detalhados.
É Stakeholder ou Ator?
Stakeholder = quem tem interesse no sistema (pode não usá-lo diretamente).
Ator (Caso de Uso) = quem INTERAGE diretamente com o sistema.
Todo Ator é Stakeholder; nem todo Stakeholder é Ator.
É Premissa ou Restrição?
Premissa = fato ASSUMIDO como verdadeiro sem confirmação formal. Pode mudar.
Restrição = limite IMPOSTO que não pode ser negociado (lei, orçamento, prazo, tech).
É escopo IN ou OUT?
IN = funcionalidade que o SISTEMA DO PROJETO vai implementar.
OUT = funcionalidade que fica em outro sistema ou versão futura.

interagirá com o sistema proposto [RoCa2002].
Um storyboard é um cenário visualizado. Ele se parece com uma história em quadrinhos, 
com um conjunto de imagens e/ou capturas de tela e, portanto, visualiza como um sistema 
ou produto deve ser usado. A reflexão sobre um exemplo concreto permite que clientes e 
usuários visualizem os requisitos na situação real do aplicativo e, assim, os revisem e alterem 
[RiFl2014].
3.3 Ferramentas de pensamento (L2)
As técnicas de elicitação apresentadas até agora representam técnicas que descrevem 
uma determinada maneira de coletar informações ou produzir um determinado produto de 
trabalho para fins de elicitação de requisitos.
Nesta seção, são apresentadas técnicas que cruzam esses tipos de técnicas, pois 
promovem uma determinada maneira de pensar. Nós as chamamos de técnicas de apoio e 
ferramentas de pensamento, porque elas não são aplicadas sozinhas, mas em conjunto com 
outras técnicas.
3.3.1 Pensamento em níveis de abstração (L2)
Os níveis de abstração são uma poderosa ferramenta de raciocínio na elicitação de 
requisitos [GoWo2005], [Laue2014]. Eles costumam ser usados como um tipo de modelo de 
processo para estruturar o trabalho de elicitação, ou seja, primeiro elicite os requisitos 
apenas no nível mais alto e continue com os níveis seguintes. Além disso, pode ser usado 
para estruturar as informações de requisitos obtidas, para identificar lacunas nos requisitos 
ou requisitos desnecessários e para concentrar as atividades de elicitação em um 
determinado nível de abstração. Por exemplo, em um workshop com usuários, é 
aconselhável concentrar-se no contexto do sistema, pois os usuários são os especialistas no 
contexto do sistema. Falar sobre as estruturas de dados de um sistema pode não ser 
apropriado, pois os usuários não se importam com as estruturas de dados internas.

É Stakeholder ou Ator?
Stakeholder = quem tem interesse no sistema (pode não usá-lo diretamente).
Ator (Caso de Uso) = quem INTERAGE diretamente com o sistema.
Todo Ator é Stakeholder; nem todo Stakeholder é Ator.
É Premissa ou Restrição?
Premissa = fato ASSUMIDO como verdadeiro sem confirmação formal. Pode mudar.
Restrição = limite IMPOSTO que não pode ser negociado (lei, orçamento, prazo, tech).
É escopo IN ou OUT?
IN = funcionalidade que o SISTEMA DO PROJETO vai implementar.
OUT = funcionalidade que fica em outro sistema ou versão futura.

5.2 Vertentes de Processos de Engenharia de Requisitos (L2)
Há três vertentes decisivas que precisam ser consideradas na configuração de um processo 
da ER [Glin2019].
Dimensão de Tempo: Sequencial vs. Iterativo
Em um processo linear, os requisitos são especificados antecipadamente em uma única 
fase do processo. Em um processo iterativo, os requisitos são especificados gradualmente, 
começando com objetivos gerais e alguns requisitos iniciais, adicionando ou modificando os 
requisitos a cada iteração.
Critérios para a escolha de um processo de ER linear:
▪ O processo de desenvolvimento do sistema é orientado a planejamento antecipado 
e, na sua maioria, sequencial.
▪ Os stakeholders conhecem seus requisitos e podem especificá-los 
antecipadamente.
▪ Uma especificação abrangente dos requisitos é necessária como base contratual 
para terceirizar o projeto e a implementação do sistema.
▪ Autoridades regulatórias exigem uma especificação abrangente e formalmente 
liberada dos requisitos em uma fase inicial do desenvolvimento.
Critérios para a escolha de um processo da ER iterativo:
▪ O processo de desenvolvimento do sistema é iterativo e ágil.
▪ Muitos requisitos não são conhecidos previamente, mas vão surgir e evoluir durante o 
desenvolvimento do sistema.
▪ Os stakeholders estão disponíveis de tal forma que podem ser estabelecidos 
pequenos ciclos de feedback como forma de mitigar o risco de desenvolver o 
sistema errado.
▪ A duração do desenvolvimento permite mais do que apenas uma ou duas iterações.
▪ A capacidade de mudar facilmente os requisitos é importante.
Dimensões de Finalidade: Prescritivo vs. Exploratório
Num processo da ER prescritivo, a especificação dos requisitos constitui um contrato: todos 
os requisitos são obrigatórios e devem ser implementados. Em um processo da ER 
exploratório, apenas os objetivos são conhecidos a priori, enquanto os requisitos concretos 
têm que ser explorados.
Critérios para a escolha de um processo da ER prescritivo:
▪ O cliente necessita de um contrato fixo para o desenvolvimento do sistema.
▪ A funcionalidade e o escopo têm precedência sobre o custo e os prazos.
▪ O desenvolvimento do sistema especificado pode ser licitado ou terceirizado.

1.3 Princípios Fundamentais de Qualidade de Requisitos
Base: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018 §5.2 — Características do requisito individual
• Necessário: Existe uma necessidade real que o justifica. Sem o requisito, há uma lacuna de negócio.
• Não ambíguo: Tem uma única interpretação possível. Evitar: 'eficiente', 'fácil', 'rápido', 'amigável'.
• Verificável: Pode ser testado objetivamente com critério mensurável. 'Rápido' não é verificável; '< 2 s' é.
• Singular: Descreve uma única coisa. Nunca usar 'e' ou 'ou' para combinar dois comportamentos em um 
RF.
• Viável: Tecnicamente e financeiramente possível dentro das restrições do projeto.
• Rastreável: Tem origem (stakeholder ou RN) e destino (caso de teste) identificados.
• Completo: Contém todas as informações necessárias para implementação sem consultas adicionais.
• Consistente: Não conflita com nenhum outro requisito do documento.
• Priorizado: Tem um nível de prioridade definido (MoSCoW: Must/Should/Could/Won't).PARTE 2 — Padrões de Escrita por Artefato

de ideias e fornecem técnicas adicionais ou combinadas para elaborar ideias e obter mais 
insights para uma determinada ideia [Kuma2013]. As técnicas populares para esse fim 
incluem prototipagem (p. ex., maquetes), storyboards e cenários.
Condições prévias para a criatividade
A criatividade surge não por ordem, mas por acaso. É mais provável que a criatividade 
ocorra quando todas as quatro condições prévias a seguir forem atendidas [KrSc2017]:
▪ Chance – e, portanto, tempo – para que uma ideia surja
▪ Conhecimento do assunto, o que aumenta as chances de uma ideia que faça a 
diferença
▪ Motivação, pois o nosso cérebro só pode ser criativo se houver um benefício direto 
para o seu dono
▪ Segurança e proteção, pois ideias inúteis não devem ter consequências negativas
As técnicas de geração de ideias e de design ajudam em alguns ou em todos esses aspectos 
a criar um ambiente adequado para o desenvolvimento de novas ideias e inovações.
3.2.1 Brainstorming (L3)
O brainstorming foi desenvolvido nas décadas de 1940 e 1950 por Alex F. Osborn 
[Osbo1979]. Como a maioria das técnicas de criatividade, o ponto crucial do brainstorming é 
a separação entre a descoberta de ideias e a análise de ideias. É realizado em grupos de 
cerca de 5 a 10 pessoas e dura cerca de 20 minutos. Um moderador garante a condução 
ordenada do brainstorming e a documentação das ideias.
Muitas variantes diferentes evoluíram ao longo do tempo, por exemplo, paradoxo do 
brainstorming, método 6-3-5, brainwriting.
3.2.2 Técnicas de analogia (L2)
As técnicas de analogia (p. ex., a bissociação [Koes1964]) são técnicas que ajudam a ter 
ideias para tópicos críticos e complexos. Eles usam analogias para apoiar o pensamento e 
gerar ideias. Seu sucesso ou fracasso é influenciado principalmente pela qualidade da 
analogia. A relevância de sistemas semelhantes é discutida em 2.4.
3.2.3 Prototipagem (L3)
Prototipagem é um termo abrangente e refere-se à criação de vários tipos de amostras ou 
modelos iniciais construídos para obter experiências ao vivo com um conceito ou processo.
Para a elicitação de requisitos, o termo protótipo intencionalmente não se refere apenas à 
implementação de protótipos em software. Em vez disso, também se refere a tudo que 
possa representar os requisitos de um sistema a ser desenvolvido (p. ex., esboço da 
interface do usuário, maquete física, vídeo). O objetivo da prototipagem na elicitação de 
requisitos é a simulação do novo sistema e a exploração dos requisitos por meio da 
estimulação de concordância e objeção ou esclarecimento e alteração.

2.2 Escopo — Como Identificar IN e OUT no Texto
O escopo é delimitado por afirmações sobre o que o sistema FAZ, o que ele NÃO FAZ, e o que está

[OUT explícito] 'não faz parte do escopo', 'fora do escopo', 'não será contemplado', 'versão futura'

Regras de negócio são POLÍTICAS, CONDIÇÕES e FÓRMULAS que o negócio impõe. Elas existem

GABARITO — Project Scenario 8: BECS (Book E-Commerce System)
Use: "ground_truth" field for RAGAS (context_precision / context_recall).
Each line is an atomic, checkable claim against the scenario text and the
knowledge base — not a full SRS, just the set of facts a well-grounded SRS
for this scenario should be able to cover.

- Any visitor can create an account with no verification process.
- Logged-in users can search for books by title only, with an exact match (no partial matches, no search by author).
- Users can view a book's title, author, and price, add it to a cart, and check out.
- Only one copy of each book can be purchased per order.
- Members (a subset of registered users) can apply promo codes at checkout.
- The manager (a single login-based account) can add books, edit prices, and view stock levels.
- The system must automatically notify the manager by email when a book's stock is low, unless notifications are disabled for that specific book.
- The manager can create percentage-off promotions; creating one automatically emails all members.
- The system does not process real credit card payments; it only collects a card number, produces a receipt, and logs the purchase (item, buyer, timestamp).
- Encryption and password recovery are explicitly out of scope for this version.
- There is only one manager account; no multi-manager roles are needed.
- A manager account must never also be a regular customer account.
- The system must run as a normal browser-accessible web application, with no exotic technical requirements.

casos_de_uso.pre_condicao: The visitor does not have a customer account.
casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_sucesso: A customer account is created and can be used for authentication.
fluxo_principal: 1. The visitor opens the registration page.
2. The visitor enters the required account information.
3. The visitor submits the registration.
4. The system validates the submitted fields.
5. The system creates the account without a separate verification step.
fluxos_alternativos: 4a. A required field is missing → the system identifies the field; returns to step 2.
fluxos_excecao: 4b. The account identifier already exists → the system rejects registration and displays 'Account already exists' (ref. RF-001).

casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_sucesso: Books with the exact submitted title are displayed.
casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_falha: No book is selected or added to the cart.
fluxo_principal: 1. The customer opens the catalog search.
2. The customer enters a complete book title.
3. The system performs an exact-title comparison.
4. The system displays matching books with title, author, price, and availability.
fluxos_alternativos: 3a. No exact title exists → the system displays an empty result with 'No exact title match found'.
fluxos_excecao: 2b. The search value is empty → the system requests a complete title and does not execute the search (ref. RN-001, RF-004).

casos_de_uso.pre_condicao: The customer is authenticated and the selected book is available.
casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_sucesso: The cart contains one copy of the selected book.
fluxo_principal: 1. The customer selects an available book.
2. The customer requests that the book be added to the cart.
3. The system confirms that the book is not already in the cart.
4. The system adds one copy to the cart.
5. The system displays the updated cart.
fluxos_alternativos: 5a. The customer removes a book → the system deletes the selected cart item.
fluxos_excecao: 3b. The book is already in the cart → the system rejects the addition and displays 'Only one copy of each book is allowed per order' (ref. RN-003, RF-007).

casos_de_uso.pre_condicao: The customer is authenticated and is not already a member.
casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_sucesso: The customer account has active member status.
fluxo_principal: 1. The customer opens promotional preferences.
2. The customer opts in to promotional communications.
3. The system records the opt-in.
4. The system activates member status.
fluxos_alternativos: 2a. The customer does not opt in → the system preserves non-member status.
fluxos_excecao: 3b. The preference cannot be saved → the system displays 'Membership enrollment failed' and preserves the previous status (ref. RN-004, RF-006).

casos_de_uso.pre_condicao: The customer is authenticated and the cart contains at least one available book.
casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_sucesso: The order is recorded, stock is updated, and a receipt is generated.
casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_falha: No order or stock change is recorded.
fluxo_principal: 1. The customer opens checkout.
2. The system displays the cart total.
3. The customer enters a card number.
4. The customer submits the order.
5. The system completes the order without contacting a real payment processor.
6. The system records the purchase.
7. The system deducts one stock unit for each purchased book.
8. The system generates the receipt.
fluxos_alternativos: 3a. The customer is a member and provides a valid code → the system applies the percentage discount before step 4.
fluxos_excecao: 4b. A cart book is no longer available → the system rejects checkout and displays 'Book unavailable' (ref. RF-012, RF-026).

casos_de_uso.pre_condicao: The member is authenticated, has an active cart, and is at checkout.
casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_sucesso: The valid percentage discount is reflected in the checkout total.
fluxo_principal: 1. The member enters a promotional code.
2. The system validates the code.
3. The system confirms the customer's member status.
4. The system calculates the percentage discount.
5. The system displays the discounted total.
fluxos_alternativos: 2a. The code is invalid → the system displays 'Invalid promotional code' and preserves the original total.
fluxos_excecao: 3b. The customer is not a member → the system rejects the code and displays 'Promotional codes are available to members only' (ref. RN-002, RF-010).

casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_sucesso: The new book is stored in the catalog.
casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_falha: No new catalog record is created.
fluxo_principal: 1. The manager opens the catalog administration area.
2. The manager enters the new book information.
3. The manager submits the book.
4. The system validates the information.
5. The system adds the book to the catalog.
fluxos_alternativos: 2a. The manager sets initial stock and a low-stock threshold → the system stores those values with the book.
fluxos_excecao: 4b. Required information is missing → the system identifies the missing fields and does not create the book (ref. RF-017).

casos_de_uso.pre_condicao: The manager is authenticated and the book exists.
casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_sucesso: The selected inventory value is updated.
casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_falha: The existing inventory value is preserved.
fluxo_principal: 1. The manager selects a book.
2. The system displays its current stock.
3. The manager enters a new stock quantity.
4. The system validates the quantity.
5. The system saves the stock quantity.
fluxos_alternativos: 3a. The manager changes the price → the system validates and stores the new price.
3b. The manager changes the low-stock threshold → the system stores the new threshold.
3c. The manager disables alerts → the system marks alerts as disabled for the book.
fluxos_excecao: 4b. The submitted quantity is negative → the system rejects the update and displays 'Stock quantity cannot be negative' (ref. RF-020).

casos_de_uso.pre_condicao: A book has an enabled alert and a configured low-stock threshold.
casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_sucesso: A low-stock email request is submitted to the email service.
casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_falha: The notification failure is recorded without changing stock.
fluxo_principal: 1. A stock update causes the quantity to reach or fall below the threshold.
2. The system verifies that alerts are enabled for the book.
3. The system creates a low-stock email.
4. The system submits the email to the configured delivery service.
fluxos_alternativos: 2a. Alerts are disabled → the system does not create an email.
fluxos_excecao: 4b. The email service is unavailable → the system records the failed submission (ref. RN-005, RF-023).

casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_sucesso: The promotion is created and notification requests are submitted for active members.
fluxo_principal: 1. The manager opens promotion management.
2. The manager enters a promotional code and percentage discount.
3. The manager submits the promotion.
4. The system validates the percentage.
5. The system creates the promotion.
6. The system identifies all active members.
7. The system submits a promotion email for every active member.
fluxos_alternativos: 6a. No active members exist → the promotion remains created and no email is submitted.
fluxos_excecao: 4b. The percentage is outside the accepted range → the system rejects creation and displays 'Discount percentage must be greater than 0 and no greater than 100' (ref. RN-006, RF-024).

casos_de_uso.pos_condicao_sucesso: The manager can view recorded purchase details.
fluxo_principal: 1. The manager opens the purchase log.
2. The system retrieves completed purchases.
3. The system displays the purchased books, customer identifier, and completion timestamp for each purchase.
fluxos_alternativos: 2a. No purchases exist → the system displays 'No purchases recorded'.
fluxos_excecao: 2b. Purchase records cannot be retrieved → the system displays 'Purchase log unavailable' (ref. RN-011, RF-027).

em_escopo: Account creation for any visitor, with no verification process
Book search by exact title match (logged-in users)
Viewing book title, author, and price
Shopping cart with a limit of one copy per book per order
Checkout flow that collects a card number, generates a receipt, and logs the purchase
Member signup to receive promotion notifications and use promo codes at checkout
Manager login to manage inventory (add books, edit prices, view stock)
Automatic low-stock email alert to the manager, with per-book opt-out
Manager-created percentage-off promotions with automatic email to all members
fora_de_escopo: Real credit card / payment processing — deferred to a later phase
Encryption — not a priority for this version
Password recovery — not a priority for this version
Multiple manager accounts or manager roles — only one manager
Partial/fuzzy search or search by author — title search is exact-match only
Multiple copies of the same book per order — limited to one
premissas: PA-01: Only one person will operate the manager account for the store.
restricoes: REST-01 (Tecnica): The system must be usable through a normal web browser, with no exotic client-side requirements.

stakeholders.descricao: Store Manager — the single account responsible for managing inventory (add books, edit prices, view stock) and creating promotions; must never also be a regular customer account.
Visitor — anyone arriving at the site who can create an account with no verification process.
Registered User / Customer — logged-in user who can search for books, add them to a cart, and check out.
Member — a registered user who opted in to promotion notifications; the only type of user who can apply promo codes at checkout.

regras_de_negocio.descricao: A cart may contain at most one copy of each distinct book per order.
A manager account must never also function as a regular customer account.
Only members (not all registered users) can apply promo codes at checkout.
The low-stock email alert to the manager is suppressed for a given book if the manager has disabled notifications for that specific book.
Creating a new percentage-off promotion automatically triggers an email to all members.

requisitos_funcionais.descricao: The system must allow any visitor to create an account with no verification process.
The system must allow logged-in users to search for books by title using an exact match only (no partial match, no search by author).
The system must display each book's title, author, and price.
The system must allow users to add a book to their shopping cart.
The system must prevent a user from adding more than one copy of the same book to their cart in a single order.
The system must allow users to complete checkout for the items in their cart.
The system must allow a registered user to sign up as a member to receive promotion notifications.
The system must allow members to apply a promo code during checkout.
The system must provide a login for the manager, separate from customer accounts.
The system must allow the manager to add new books to the inventory.
The system must allow the manager to edit the price of existing books.
The system must allow the manager to view current stock levels.
The system must send an email notification to the manager when a book's stock is low, unless notifications are disabled for that book.
The system must allow the manager to create percentage-off promotions.
The system must automatically email all members when a new promotion is created.
The system must collect a card number during checkout without processing an actual payment.
The system must generate a receipt after checkout.
The system must log each purchase, including the item, the buyer, and the timestamp.

requisitos_nao_funcionais.descricao: The system must be usable through a standard web browser, with no exotic or non-standard client-side requirements.

historias_de_usuario.descricao: As a visitor, I want to create an account with no verification process, so that I can start using the site quickly.
As a registered user, I want to search for a book by its exact title, so that I can find the book I'm looking for.
As a registered user, I want to view a book's title, author, and price, so that I can decide whether to buy it.
As a registered user, I want to add a book to my cart, so that I can purchase it later.
As a registered user, I want to check out my cart, so that I can complete my purchase.
As a member, I want to apply a promo code at checkout, so that I can get a discount.
As the manager, I want to add new books and edit their prices, so that I can keep the catalog up to date.
As the manager, I want to be notified when a book's stock is low, so that I can restock in time.
As the manager, I want to create percentage-off promotions, so that I can attract more sales.
As a member, I want to receive an email when a new promotion is created, so that I know about current deals.

casos_de_uso.descricao: Search and Purchase Book — a logged-in user searches for a book by exact title, adds it to the cart, and completes checkout.
Manage Inventory — the manager logs in and adds new books, edits prices, or views current stock levels.
Create Promotion — the manager creates a percentage-off promotion, and the system automatically emails all members.

criterios_de_aceite.descricao: Given a logged-in user, when they search for a book title that exactly matches an existing book, then the system returns that book with its title, author, and price.
Given a user already has one copy of a book in their cart, when they try to add another copy of the same book, then the system prevents the second copy from being added.
Given a member is at checkout with a valid promo code, when they apply the code, then the system applies the corresponding discount.
Given a book's stock drops below the defined threshold and notifications are enabled for that book, when the stock update occurs, then the system sends an email to the manager.
Given the manager creates a new percentage-off promotion, when the promotion is saved, then the system automatically sends an email to all members.
